notes.en: Static guide review draft: pinned source, exact license bytes, fact/commitment ledgers, privacy, approval and send-authority boundaries, and synthetic examples were checked. The draft never sends, writes to a CRM or support tool, grants a credit or refund, or overrides current Floe/user/organization communication policy. No script, dependency, connector or execution is present. This unsigned draft is not a production review approval and makes no model-run, guest-execution, installation or App acceptance claim.
